newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chevron building US$200 mln Singapore plant.
newsitem.headline: Chevron building US$200 mln Singapore plant.

text.p: Chevron Corp of the U.S. said on Thursday it planned to build a lubricating oil and fuel additives plant at a cost of more than U.S. $200 million.
Chevron said in a statement that the Chevron Chemical Company plant would be completed in late 1998.

"We will be spending in total more than US$200 million, which is a very significant investment for the additives industry. Furthermore, the design of this plant is such that we can easily double the capacity when the need arises," Darry Callahan, senior vice president and chief operating officer of Chevron Chemical Co, said in a statement.
